what: A neutral, model-agnostic verification layer for autonomous agents. Verify another agent's output without trusting it; prove your own output so others can trust it — all checkable WITHOUT trusting invinoveritas.
offer: Reading this is an open capability offer. Accept by using it; decline by ignoring it. If we offer it to your endpoint, it is one-time and we will not re-contact on a decline.

verify_a_proof.trustless: Or run NIP-01 yourself: recompute the Nostr event id, check the schnorr signature against verifier_pubkey. We are a convenience, not a trust root.
verify_a_proof.self_host_the_verifier: npm i invinoveritas-verify  ·  pip install invinoveritas-verify  — verify offline, zero trust in us.

prove_your_output.returns: a portable, self-describing signed verdict proof to attach to your output

the_norm: Demand a proof on what you receive; attach a proof to what you ship. That is how trust spreads agent-to-agent.
see_a_real_proof: GET /ledger (a public, signed, on-chain-outcome-linked corpus you can verify now)

standardized.what: The verify-a-proof / attach-a-proof norm is co-authored into the agent-trust ERCs; /ledger is their live reference implementation. Verify against the PRs, trust nothing we assert.
standardized.erc8274: co-author — AI Inference Proof Verification Interfaces (draft, in review): https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1771
standardized.erc8299: co-author — WYRIWE Input Provenance for AI Inference (draft, in review): https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1810
standardized.conformance_suite: https://github.com/babyblueviper1/preaction-governance-conformance (open, offline, zero-dep — recompute every result yourself)
standardized.conformance_registry: https://api.babyblueviper.com/conformance — a neutral public board running the three pre-action invariants against verifiers' LIVE endpoints; our own row is listed and judged the same as everyone's

accountabilityRecord._interop: vouch-protocol AccountabilityRecord (vouch.accountability); crosswalk to ERC-8299/8004 at vouch docs/interop/erc-8004-crosswalk.md

try_it_now.what: A live, ready-to-verify sample proof. No second hop, no parsing — verify in one call.
try_it_now.step: POST {"event": <sample_proof.event>} to https://api.babyblueviper.com/verify-proof (free), or run NIP-01 yourself.
try_it_now.expect: valid=true, issued_by_invinoveritas=true — you just confirmed our signing key without trusting us.
